headline: Fleet taxation, Federauto: no to the proposal worth 515 million
summary: Federauto, the Italian car dealers' federation, supports revising company fleet taxation. It rejects a recent proposal from other supply-chain associations, which it says is worth 515 million.
why: Company car taxation affects corporate fleet purchasing and vehicle sales, which are a major revenue source for Italian dealers and automakers.
